**Format:** Vertical reel/video (9:16, 1080×1920px).

- Foreground: Close-up human (mid-chest framing, person speaking/present, direct eye contact), wearing neutral/natural tones (sage, cream, linen-texture clothing).

- Neutrals: Cream, white, warm charcoal for body text and backgrounds. No pure black, no competitor's palette.

- Headline: Satoshi Bold (700), ~95px+ on 1080 canvas, white text. ONE meaningful word in green #39B54A italic or complementary accent.
- Subline: Satoshi Medium (500), ~50–60px relative size (never rendered below 40px), white text, plain (no green, no decoration).
- Supporting card text: Satoshi Medium (500), ≥40px rendered, high contrast (white or charcoal on background).

- Logo: small, unobtrusive, top-left or corner (8–10% of frame width).

posts.caption:
Histamine intolerance and SIBO often walk hand-in-hand.

When dysbiosis takes hold, your gut produces less DAO enzyme — the protein that breaks down histamine. Suddenly, even fresh-but-fermented foods trigger bloating, brain fog, and fatigue.

The good news? A targeted 8–12 week reset — eliminating histamine triggers whilst restoring your gut lining and microbiome — can turn this around.

We work through this with real data: stool testing, elimination tracking, and a staged reintroduction plan. No guessing, no restrictive forever-diet.

If you're stuck in the SIBO–histamine loop, let's talk.

Book a functional gut assessment today.

#SIBORecovery #HistamineIntolerance #GutHealth #FunctionalMedicine #Adelaide

**Frame 2 (bottom ~50%):** A different angle or complementary visual (e.g., close-up of hands, another frame of the same person, or a second person in conversation). Creates visual rhythm and maintains face presence.

**Text overlay design:**
- Bold sans-serif text (Satoshi Bold, ~90–100px+ for maximum impact on 1080 canvas) on a horizontal band positioned centrally across both frames.
- Black or charcoal background strip for the text band (NOT pure black; a soft charcoal ~#2C2C2C or #3A3A3A works).
- Primary text in white (high contrast, clean).
- **One key phrase highlighted in EHN green #39B54A** — e.g., "FOOD SENSITIVITIES?" — rendered in italic or slightly smaller bold to signal emphasis.
- Minimal text density — no more than 8 words total on the reel hook.
- Example on-card text: "COULD FOOD SENSITIVITIES BE BEHIND YOUR SYMPTOMS?" with "FOOD SENSITIVITIES?" in green.

- Primary anchor: EHN green #39B54A (the highlighted word on the text band).

posts.on_image:
Headline: Understanding Gut Dysbiosis

Sarah Chen
Accredited Practising Dietitian

Dysbiosis—an imbalance in your gut bacteria—is one of the most common drivers of digestive symptoms we see in clinic. It's often the quiet cause behind bloating, irregular bowel habits, and that persistent fatigue you can't quite shake.

When your microbiome loses diversity and the "bad" bacteria outweigh the "good," your gut barrier weakens. Food sits longer, fermentation increases, and you feel the bloating.

SIBO (small intestinal bacterial overgrowth) is a specific form of dysbiosis where bacteria colonise the small intestine instead of staying in the colon. This is where breath testing and targeted dietary intervention come in.

Learn how to restore your gut health

Elemental Health & Nutrition
